purpose: Preserve Word list numbering when labels and expressions are split; protect a year-leading continuation from becoming a spurious row.
authority: Normative Cochrane Ovid MEDLINE-to-PubMed Conversion Rules v20
reference_v20_v2_note: Split list labels themselves are supported, but the normative v20 year-leading continuation protection is documented as absent in the current executable. The physical continuation beginning '2020 ' must remain part of strategy row 2.
mesh_stub_note: Fixture-only deterministic MeSH metadata. IDs/URIs are deliberately synthetic and must not be treated as production NLM data.
